purpose: Make every Buddy capability usable as a composable, measurable unit inside arbitrary user jobs.
composition_rules: Capabilities may be chained, parallelized, nested, or repeated.
A capability may call another capability only through a declared contract.
Each capability must expose inputs, outputs, prerequisites, limitations, tests, and evidence.
The orchestrator must preserve provenance across composed capabilities.
One failed capability must not erase successful sibling work.
The scheduler must continue productive work while retaining unresolved hard tasks.
progress_rule: After completion, identify the highest-value improvement to the capability or workflow and create a harder follow-up benchmark when appropriate.
honesty_rule: No capability, workflow, model, or task may be marked successful without supporting evidence.
